Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Limit mic boost on VAIO PRO PX

The internal mic boost on the VAIO models VJFE-CL and VJFE-IL is too high.
Fix this by applying the ALC269_FIXUP_LIMIT_INT_MIC_BOOST fixup to the machine
to limit the gain.
